HANGS General Contracting LP · Notes to the FY2026 financial statements (excerpt)
1. Revenue on contracts is recognized over time, measured by costs incurred to date against estimated total costs. Retainage
receivable is classified as current under the operating cycle of the contracts, which may exceed one year.
2. Debt. The revolving line of credit with Cinderbrook Bank ($1,800,000.00 at June 30, 2026) is due at maturity on March 31, 2027.
The equipment term loan ($2,880,000.00) is payable at $60,000.00 a month with the balance due on March 31, 2030; $720,000.00
is due within one year. On March 16, 2026 the bank applied $180,000.00 from an equipment sale to the term loan. Interest is
recorded when the bank debits it.
3. Related party. The partnership builds Juniper Ridge Partners (job J-2625) for Juniper Ridge Partners LLC, under the same
owners. At June 30, 2026 it owed $277,875.00 (account 1210) and $14,625.00 of retainage.
4. Leases. The partnership leases its office under a lease that began a new 60-month term on January 1, 2026. The partnership has
not recognized right-of-use assets or lease liabilities. At June 30, 2026 the present value of the remaining office rent, discounted at
7.10%, was $1,484,173.90, of which $290,219.17 is due within one year. Equipment rentals are expensed as incurred.
Prepared by Dana Whitfield, Controller. Reviewed by the partners on October 20, 2026.
